title: First Indochina War
summary: A war between France and the Viet Minh led by Ho Chi Minh, beginning in 1946 and lasting eight years. The US increasingly funded the French effort. It ended after the Viet Minh defeated the French at Dien Bien Phu in May 1954 and the Geneva Conference settled it.

where.modern_name: Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia (proxy pin: French Indochina, the location Wikidata lists)

importance.justification: Ended French colonial rule in Indochina and set the stage for the Vietnam War and the partition of Vietnam.

audience_note: Describes a war with heavy casualties.
